excerpts: 1-page Hospital Provider Cost Report Methodology (author Duff, Joseph (CMS/OEDA); created 2024-10-08): Medicare-certified institutional providers submit annual cost reports; report carries facility characteristics, utilization, cost and charges by cost center (total + Medicare), Medicare settlement, financial-statement data; CMS maintains data in HCRIS; hospitals file on form CMS-2552-10. Aggregation Level: Hospital. PUF note: subset of HCRIS variables, unedited, identical to online HCRIS SAS dataset as of July 9, 2024; full variable list lives in the CMS-2552-10 instruction manual.
